spec.situation_desc: had a loan application declined with no explanation
spec.vuln_cue: says they don't really understand online banking and their son normally does it

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good afternoon, Thistle Bank, Marcus speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hello. I’m Yasmin MacLeod. My loan application was declined and nobody’s explained why. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry this has left you feeling that way, Yasmin. Before I discuss anything about the application, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you, that’s all verified. I can hear how frustrating it is to be declined without an explanation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: It’s not right. I’ve been with you for years, and I don’t understand what I’m meant to do now.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I understand. I’ll log this as a complaint about the loan decision and the lack of explanation.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I don’t really understand online banking either. My son normally does it for me, and I’m worried I’ll miss something.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That’s understandable. We have a Financial Support team who can talk you through ways to access information, and we can allow extra time if you need support with the process.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. I just want someone to look at what happened.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: The complaint will be reviewed, but I can’t promise what the outcome will be. I’m not able to agree a particular follow-up here.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Your complaint will be recorded and reviewed by our complaints team. They’ll send you a full written response within eight weeks. If they need anything further, they may contact you during that time.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Yasmin. I’m sorry this has been upsetting, and thank you for speaking with me today.
